verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party bulk-operation capability, such as batch API requests, bulk user edits, or CSV bulk actions across many items. What it does show is only adjacent: Apps Script as a low-code automation building block, a paginated users list (retrieval, not bulk action), automatic provisioning sync to third-party apps, group-level 2SV enforcement, and dynamic groups. None of these is a documented capability for performing operations across many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
